items.title: Marian McPartland interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, April 26, 1997
items.q: he and Paul used to come in the club

ctx.x: Yeah. And I still berate Dave Brubeck whenever I see him because he and Paul used to come in the club and I would think oh isn’t that nice they really like the trio. But they were really coming in to size up Joe and steal him. But I mean Joe had to move on, he couldn’t stay with me forever. But anyway, thinking back, ten years of being in there was a good gig.
You had a lot of times — would you feel pressured when Duke Ellington came in the room, or — I mean I know you went out of your way to play some of his tunes and he apparently liked it.
